g.text: Bun, a popular JavaScript runtime, has been updated to version 1.3.14
The latest release of Bun includes contributions
and bug fixes to the platform. According to the
release notes, the update addresses several
issues and enhances the overall stability and
performance of Bun. The changes are aimed at
providing a smoother experience for developers,
allowing them to build and deploy applications
more efficiently. With this update, Bun continues
to evolve as a versatile and reliable tool for
modern web development, offering a range of
features and capabilities that cater to the needs
of a wide range of users. The release marks
another step forward in the ongoing development
